Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material.why: Makes single-lane 224G high-speed copper communication cable, in scaled delivery as the main product of its high-speed cable business, and pushes it into AI computing and data centers (448G in customer validation); high-speed cable revenue rose 237.99% in 2025, so AI data-center copper interconnect build-out directly drives its communication cable segment.
Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material.evidence: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026): single-lane 224G high-speed communication cable keeps adding variants and remains in scaled delivery as the main product of the high-speed cable business; H1 2026 high-speed communication cable revenue RMB 6.31 hundred million, up 35.44%; the company is promoting high-speed cable applications in AI computing and data centers.

players.product: Single-lane 224G high-speed copper communication cable (twinax wire for DAC / server cable assemblies); single-lane 448G cable in customer validation and PCIe 7.0 high-speed cable in small-batch trial production

quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material IR activity record: 2026-007 (09-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): optical modules and copper cables each have advantages and are used for different transmission distances and application scenarios in the data center; optical modules, copper cables and other solutions may coexist in the future. The company will keep following high-speed cable industry trends and customer needs and keep its product development agile.

quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material IR activity record: 2026-007 (09-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): gross margin is affected by product mix, raw-material prices and market competition and fluctuates by phase; H1 2026 communication cable gross margin of 18.79%, down 2.94%, mainly reflected higher prices of silver and other raw materials, plus more R&D and market-development spending, more capital investment and a larger leased area, which raised the segment's operating costs and period expenses. The company plans to lift competitiveness and profitability through technology innovation and product upgrades, a better product and customer mix and higher production efficiency, and to tighten cost control while watching raw-material prices.
